name: AXON ENTERPRISE, INC.
moat_justification: Dominant integrated public-safety ecosystem (TASER + body cameras + Evidence.com cloud) with high switching costs once an agency's evidence workflow and training are built around it; ARR ~$1.6B growing +39% at 126% net revenue retention and $15.1B future contracted bookings evidence the lock-in. Not 9-10: public-sector customers buy through budget cycles and competitive bidding, capping pricing power, and Motorola Solutions contests the same agencies.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 4.3%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
one_liner: Elite public-safety franchise, moat 8/10, growing ~33%/yr — but SBC ($634M in FY2025) exceeds OCF after capex, so conservative owner's earnings are negative on every basis (median -$0.68/sh, TTM -$6.06/sh) and it cannot clear 15% at $418; Tier F until SBC normalizes.
moat_for: Dominant TASER + body-camera installed base bundled with Evidence.com cloud — integrated ecosystem, not point products
High switching costs: evidence storage, chain-of-custody workflow, officer training, multi-year bundled contracts
Recurring-revenue engine compounding: ARR ~$1.6B (+39%), net revenue retention 126%, future contracted bookings $15.1B (+41%)
Brand/trust position in law enforcement; proven wallet-share expansion per agency (cameras to software to drones/AI)
moat_against: Public-sector customers: budget cycles, political scrutiny, open competitive bidding cap pricing power
Motorola Solutions and others contest the same agencies; no consumer-style network effect
Growth increasingly carried by newer lines (Dedrone, Platform Solutions, AI) with thinner, unproven moats
